contraindication_rules.description: ACL reconstruction early rehab: no deep squats, jumping, or pivoting
ACL reconstruction mid rehab: no jumping, pivoting, sprinting, or high-impact activities
ACL reconstruction late rehab: no competitive sports or uncontrolled direction changes
ACL early phase: no open-chain knee extension or heavy resistance in first 4 weeks
ACL mid rehab early phase: no lateral agility drills, plyometrics, or single-leg jumps
Rotator cuff early rehab: no overhead pressing, heavy lifting, push-ups, or active shoulder abduction
Rotator cuff mid rehab: no heavy lifting, overhead throwing, bench press, or high-resistance pulling
Rotator cuff late rehab: no max-effort throwing, heavy bench press, or overhead snatch
Rotator cuff first 4 weeks: only passive ROM, no active ROM or resistance exercises
Rotator cuff mid rehab early: no overhead weights, heavy lateral raises, or explosive movements
Chronic lower back early rehab: no heavy deadlifts, loaded spinal twists, sit-ups, or high-impact activities
Chronic lower back mid rehab: no heavy deadlifts, barbell squats, or high-impact jumping
Chronic lower back late rehab: no max-effort deadlifts or loaded hyperextensions
Chronic lower back acute phase: no loaded forward flexion, rotation under load, prolonged sitting exercises, or heavy leg press
Chronic lower back mid rehab: no plyometrics, box jumps, or heavy overhead pressing
ACL early rehab: no running, stair running, or agility ladder drills

dosage_rules.description: High pain: restrict to gentle stretching and rest only
Moderate pain: reduce intensity, allow light cardio, balance, and stretching
Pain spike (+3 from last session): step back to gentle exercises and reassess
Combined moderate fatigue and pain: restrict to gentle activities and breathing exercises
Pain with swelling: RICE protocol only, no active exercises
Low pain and low fatigue: allow full progression including higher-intensity exercises
Poor sleep quality: reduce exercise volume, focus on lighter activities
3+ consecutive high pain days: mandatory rest and recommend consulting provider
Moderate pain in early rehab: restrict to passive ROM and rest protocols

fatigue_rules.description: Severe fatigue: only rest and gentle stretching
Moderate fatigue: reduce volume, allow stretching, balance, and breathing exercises
Accumulated fatigue with 4+ consecutive exercise days: mandatory rest day
High fatigue in older adults (60+): extended rest period with only gentle mobility
Fatigue spike (+4 from last session): reduce load and reassess recovery capacity
Combined high fatigue and moderate pain: complete rest recommended

crisis_rules.message: This sounds concerning. Please stop all exercises and consult your healthcare provider immediately.
crisis_rules.message_zh: 这听起来令人担忧。请立即停止所有运动，并尽快联系您的医疗保健提供者。

crisis_rules.message: Loss of movement is a serious symptom. Please stop exercising and seek medical attention immediately.
crisis_rules.message_zh: 活动能力丧失是严重症状。请立即停止运动并寻求医疗帮助。

crisis_rules.message: Numbness or tingling may indicate nerve involvement. Please stop all exercises and contact your healthcare provider.
crisis_rules.message_zh: 麻木或针刺感可能表明神经受到影响。请停止所有运动并联系您的医疗保健提供者。

crisis_rules.message: A popping sound during exercise could indicate a structural issue. Please stop immediately and seek medical evaluation.
crisis_rules.message_zh: 运动中出现弹响声可能表明结构性问题。请立即停止并寻求医学评估。
crisis_rules.description: Crisis detection: joint popping sound during exercise

crisis_rules.message: Severe or rapid swelling requires immediate medical attention. Please stop all activities and apply ice while seeking care.
crisis_rules.message_zh: 严重或快速的肿胀需要立即医疗关注。请停止所有活动，冰敷并尽快就医。
crisis_rules.description: Crisis detection: severe or rapid swelling

crisis_rules.message: Chest pain or difficulty breathing is a medical emergency. Please call emergency services (120/911) immediately.
crisis_rules.message_zh: 胸痛或呼吸困难属于医疗紧急情况。请立即拨打急救电话（120/911）。

crisis_rules.message: Dizziness or feeling faint during exercise is concerning. Please sit or lie down safely and contact your healthcare provider.
crisis_rules.message_zh: 运动中头晕或感觉要晕倒令人担忧。请安全地坐下或躺下，并联系您的医疗保健提供者。

crisis_rules.message: Joint instability or giving way could indicate a serious issue. Please stop all weight-bearing exercises and consult your surgeon.
crisis_rules.message_zh: 关节不稳或打软可能表明严重问题。请停止所有负重运动并咨询您的外科医生。

crisis_rules.message: It's completely understandable to feel this way. Recovery is tough, and it's okay to take a step back. Would you like to talk about what's making this difficult, or shall we adjust your plan?
crisis_rules.message_zh: 有这种感觉完全可以理解。康复过程很艰难，暂时退一步也没关系。您愿意聊聊是什么让您觉得困难吗，还是我们来调整一下您的计划？
crisis_rules.description: Crisis detection: emotional distress / motivation crisis

crisis_rules.message: If your surgical wound is opening or bleeding, please stop all activity immediately. Apply gentle pressure with a clean cloth and seek emergency medical care.
crisis_rules.message_zh: 如果您的手术伤口裂开或出血，请立即停止所有活动。用干净的布轻轻按压并寻求紧急医疗救助。

progression_gates.description: ACL early->mid: 6+ weeks, ROM >= 90°, avg pain <= 4, completion >= 60%
ACL mid->late: 12+ weeks, ROM >= 120°, avg pain <= 3, completion >= 70%, quad strength ratio >= 60%
ACL late->return to sport: 24+ weeks, full ROM, avg pain <= 2, completion >= 80%, strength ratio >= 85%, hop test >= 90%
Rotator cuff early->mid: 6+ weeks, passive ROM >= 120° flexion, avg pain <= 4, completion >= 60%
Rotator cuff mid->late: 12+ weeks, active ROM >= 150° flexion, avg pain <= 3, completion >= 70%
Rotator cuff late->return to activity: 24+ weeks, near-full ROM, avg pain <= 2, manual muscle test >= 4/5
Chronic LBP early->mid: 3+ weeks, avg pain <= 5, completion >= 50%, able to walk 30 min
Chronic LBP mid->late: 8+ weeks, avg pain <= 4, completion >= 60%, core endurance >= 60s plank
Chronic LBP late->maintenance: 12+ weeks, avg pain <= 3, completion >= 70%, functional score improved >= 30%
ACL early->mid (strict): 6+ weeks, ROM >= 90°, full extension, quad activation present, avg pain <= 4
